package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/egoist/mygo/internal/hotlink/testdata/host/lib"
	"github.com/egoist/mygo/internal/hotpatch"
)

type point struct{ x, y int }

// Area is called by nothing in the program, which only edits may change.
func (p *point) Area() int { return p.x * p.y }

func (p *point) sum() int { return p.x + p.y + bonus() }

var (
	calls    int
	limit    = 20
	state    = map[string]int{"kept": 42}
	sentinel = errors.New("the host's error")
	held     func() string
	work     = make(chan func() string, 1)
)

// A variable the running program does not have, holding pointers.
var added = []*shape{{name: "added"}}

//go:noinline
func bonus() int { return 100 }

// Types the program reaches in ways that have no typelink.
type onlyValue struct{ a int }
type onlyPointer struct{ a int }
type namedSlice []int

var (
	heldValue   any = onlyValue{1}
	heldPointer any = &onlyPointer{2}
	heldNamed   any = namedSlice{1, 2}
)

// dynamicIface and dynamic meet only in a conversion as the program runs.
type dynamicIface interface{ value() int }
type dynamic struct{ n int }

func (d *dynamic) value() int { return d.n }

var (
	heldDynamic dynamicIface
	source      any = &dynamic{7}
)

//go:noinline
func message() string { return "v2 " + describe(circle{r: 2}) }

// A new type, with a new interface and methods.
type shaper interface {
	area() float64
	label() string
}

type shape struct {
	name string
	next *shape
}

type circle struct{ r float64 }

func (c circle) area() float64 { return 3 * c.r * c.r }
func (c circle) label() string { return "circle" }

func describe(s shaper) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%s=%.0f (%T)", s.label(), s.area(), s) }

func mapOf[K comparable, V any](ks []K, f func(K) V) map[K]V {
	m := make(map[K]V, len(ks))
	for _, k := range ks {
		m[k] = f(k)
	}
	return m
}

//go:noinline
func deep(n int) int {
	var pad [256]byte
	pad[n%256] = byte(n)
	if n == 0 {
		return int(pad[0])
	}
	return deep(n-1) + int(pad[n%256])&1
}

//go:noinline
func catches() (out string) {
	defer func() {
		r := recover()
		_, file, line, _ := runtime.Caller(0)
		out = fmt.Sprintf("recovered %v at %s:%d", r, file[strings.LastIndexByte(file, '/')+1:], line)
	}()
	var m map[string]int
	m["boom"] = 1
	return "not reached"
}

//go:noinline
func stress() string {
	var out []string
	add := func(format string, args ...any) { out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...)) }

	// Allocation, with pointers that only this code's stack maps describe.
	nodes := []*shape{}
	for i := range 20000 {
		nodes = append(nodes, &shape{name: fmt.Sprint(i)})
	}
	runtime.GC()
	sum := 0
	for _, n := range nodes {
		sum += len(n.name)
	}
	add("alloc %d", sum)

	// The stack grows through this code, and shrinks in a collection.
	add("deep %d", deep(20000))
	runtime.GC()

	// Panics unwind through it, and its frames have names and lines.
	add("%s", catches())
	pc, _, _, _ := runtime.Caller(0)
	add("self %s", runtime.FuncForPC(pc).Name())

	// Generics, instantiated here and not in the program.
	m := mapOf([]string{"a", "bb"}, func(s string) int { return len(s) })
	add("generic %d %d", m["a"], m["bb"])

	// Goroutines and channels.
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	ch := make(chan int, 8)
	for i := range 8 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() { defer wg.Done(); runtime.Gosched(); ch <- deep(1000) + i }()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	close(ch)
	total := 0
	for v := range ch {
		total += v
	}
	add("goroutines %d", total)

	// Identity of what the program has: its errors, its types.
	err := fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", sentinel)
	add("errors.Is %v", errors.Is(err, sentinel))
	var e error = sentinel
	add("same error %v", e == sentinel)
	add("kept type %v", reflect.TypeOf(&point{}) == reflect.TypeOf(heldPoint()))
	add("switch %s", classify(any(&point{})))

	// Reflection over a new type.
	rt := reflect.TypeOf(circle{})
	add("reflect %s %d %v %v", rt.Name(), rt.NumField(), rt.Size(), added[0].name)
	return strings.Join(out, "\n") + "\n" + useLater()
}

func classify(v any) string {
	switch v.(type) {
	case *point:
		return "*point"
	case circle:
		return "circle"
	}
	return "other"
}

// useLater reaches packages and functions the program's linker dropped.
func useLater() string {
	s := []string{"b", "a"}
	slices.Sort(s)
	_ = time.Duration(0).String()
	return "dropped " + strings.Join(s, " ") + " " + strings.ToTitle("x") + strings.Repeat("y", 2) + " " + time.Unix(0, 0).UTC().Weekday().String()
}

func heldPoint() any { return &point{} }

func main() {
	addr := os.Getenv("MYGO_HOT")
	var ready sync.WaitGroup
	ready.Add(1)
	if addr != "" {
		go func() {
			err := hotpatch.Serve(addr, func(f func()) {
				done := make(chan struct{})
				work <- func() string { f(); close(done); return "" }
				<-done
			}, func() { fmt.Println("applied") })
			if err != nil {
				fmt.Println("serve:", err)
			}
		}()
	}
	lines := make(chan string)
	go func() {
		sc := bufio.NewScanner(os.Stdin)
		for sc.Scan() {
			lines <- sc.Text()
		}
		close(lines)
	}()
	held = func() string { return "the old closure " + message() }
	for {
		select {
		case f := <-work:
			f()
		case line, ok := <-lines:
			if !ok {
				return
			}
			calls++
			switch line {
			case "convert":
				heldDynamic = source.(dynamicIface)
				fmt.Println("made")
			case "message":
				fmt.Println(message())
			case "lib":
				fmt.Println(lib.Name(), lib.Version)
			case "stress":
				fmt.Println(stress())
			case "held":
				fmt.Println(held())
			case "state":
				p := &point{x: 1, y: 2}
				fmt.Println(calls, limit, state["kept"], p.sum())
			}
		}
	}
}
